name: Gomboc Code Remediation
description: Deterministic code remediation powered by ORL - fix issues with 94%+ accuracy
longDescription:
Gomboc automatically scans and fixes code issues across your entire codebase using the Open Remediation Language (ORL) — a deterministic execution engine that guarantees the same input always produces the same fix output.

Unlike traditional scanners that generate alerts, Gomboc delivers merge-ready pull requests that clear your code issues backlogs.

Key Features:
• ORL-powered deterministic fixes (not probabilistic AI)
• Syntax-tree aware matching via Tree-sitter
• 94%+ merge acceptance rate
• Support for Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, JavaScript, and 20+ languages
• Multiple output formats (JSON, Markdown, SARIF)

Designed as the perfect complement to agentic coding — pair with Claude Code for continuous, intelligent code improvement loops.
